images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a beautiful restrained editorial 3D teaching illustration for the final slide of a data center course. Wide 16:9 landscape. Warm off-white background #f4f3ee, dark teal equipment, copper and cyan accents, clean subtle ambient shadows. Three equally spaced visual groups across the canvas, lots of negative space, NO TEXT, no legends, no labels, no arrows or decorative networks. Left third: one generic modern GPU server rack seen three-quarter, with a few small abstract token tiles in front of it, clearly a workload, no recognizable manufacturer logos and no purported internal engineering detail. Center third: a clean large landscape oscilloscope or measurement display, its flat front screen totally blank pale ivory for us to overlay an accurate power trace in code; upright centered, simple dark teal slim frame, fully front-facing screen with no perspective skew. Right third: a modest coherent grouping of an electrical substation transformer, a generic compact gas generating enclosure and one battery energy-storage cabinet, all external appearance only. These three groups must remain separate, not connected by wires; this is a conceptual comparison of workload, measurement, and supply design, not a wiring diagram. Objects occupy middle 70 percent of image height, generous margins. No humans, no photoreal aerial, no invented industrial pipe schematics. Polished technical-book illustration, crisp and calm, minimal visual clutter.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original stunning minimal data center power configuration diagram, wide landscape 16:9, warm ivory background, clean architectural isometric 3D miniature illustrations with precise simple arrows and very sparse large labels. Layout is a 2 by 2 quadrant grid, equal quadrants, thin light gray vertical and horizontal dividers. Use exactly these four headers at the top of each quadrant: top left 'Grid-supplied', top right 'Grid-parallel', bottom left 'Export-only', bottom right 'Off-grid'. Each quadrant contains the SAME recognizable teal data center building on the right and simple small icons for grid transmission tower and gold local gas generator as needed. Top left: grid tower on left and data center right; one cyan arrow from grid tower TO data center. No local generator in this quadrant. Top right: grid tower upper left, gold local generator lower left, data center right; cyan arrow grid TO data center and gold arrow generator TO data center. Bottom left: grid tower upper left, gold local generator lower left, data center right; gold arrow generator TO data center and separate dashed gold arrow from generator TO grid tower. ABSOLUTELY NO arrow from grid toward data center in export-only. Bottom right: gold local generator left and data center right; gold arrow generator TO data center; NO GRID TOWER and NO GRID CONNECTION. Do not draw any additional arrows, cables, roads or paths. These are permitted supply directions, not installation wiring. No numerical capacities. No batteries, backup generators or solar panels. No bottom sentences or footer. No other text beyond the four headers. Large beautiful clear objects and confident uncluttered arrows. Prioritize electrical directional accuracy above decoration. Original composition, no brand logos, no watermark.
